text:
marta: heads up — ap-southeast1 showing a binpack stall for micro-inference pods. lots Pending (~120s+) even though free GPU slots exist.
lee: saw it. looks like node scoring is killing nodes in racks with `egress-qos:policed`. nvlink topology forces spread so scheduler can't co-locate 0.5 GPU pods.
marta: example event from stuck pod `kubectl describe pod model-worker-9`: 
Events:
  "0/12 nodes are available: 6 node(s) didn't match node affinity, 6 Insufficient networkBandwidth."
darryl: warm-pool scaled down to 1 after midnight autoscale. that's probably amplifying churn — fractional packing would be much smoother with 3 warm nodes.
lee: ops note: earlier today we bumped policer thresholds on rack-b12 due to noisy egress from customer-42. switch counters show tail spikes and a few 1-2s drops.
marta: quick mitigation options?
lee: propose two-tier plan: (A) bump warm-pool -> 3 now (short term), (B) relax `networkBandwidth` predicate for pods with annotation `inference.rw/low-egress=true` (soft). ops can watch counters.
darryl: bumping warm-pool short-term OK. cost estimate: ~18k/month if left steady with extra NVLINK nodes. pinging @finance for temporary approval.
finance: finance: please add estimated window and alert if >72h. temporary bump approved for up to 48h, re-evaluate after metrics.
ops-bot: incident-check: no active infra alerts for ap-southeast1. historical egress spike: 2026-03-19T21:08Z 78% util for 4m.
lee: also a longer-term scheduler change: treat `EvenSpread` as weaker tie-breaker when `pod.gpu.request < 1` and `gpu-topo=nvlink` present. We can prototype via schedule plugin flag `preferPackForMicroPods`.
marta: opened PR #4392 to default `inference.rw/low-egress` for micro-worker template and add a topologySpread favoring same-rack for packables.
darryl: warm-pool -> 3 applied. reschedule started, about 7/9 stuck pods transitioned to Running in ~70s. monitoring CPU/GPU and egress.
lee: good signal. will follow-up with a small simulator run to quantify cost vs latency for keeping warmpool=3 vs 6 and for adding 2 nvlink nodes.
marta: thanks — keep threads if any regression. :thumbsup:
